note.value: Boats launch after a ship moves, but before it fires. They do not interact with other ships on the turn they launch (i.e. Bomb Boats don't explode and Raiding Boats don't initiate boarding actions).
note.value_en: Boats launch after a ship moves, but before it fires. They do not interact with other ships on the turn they launch (i.e. Bomb Boats don't explode and Raiding Boats don't initiate boarding actions).

note.value: If a Bomb Boat moves into contact with an obstruction, the Bomb Boat explodes. If the obstruction is not a ship, boat or sea monster, there is no effect. Otherwise the Bomb Boat does 1 random low hit (re-roll misses with only a 1 being a miss). Save -1. Remove the Bomb Boat.
note.value_en: If a Bomb Boat moves into contact with an obstruction, the Bomb Boat explodes. If the obstruction is not a ship, boat or sea monster, there is no effect. Otherwise the Bomb Boat does 1 random low hit (re-roll misses with only a 1 being a miss). Save -1. Remove the Bomb Boat.

note.value: Main weapons may not fire on Boats. Boats may be boarded by a boarding action (note: Bomb Boats will explode prior to the action). Boats within 3" may be fired at using Defensive Fire (1 die per Crew Counter). Boats are hit on a 5+ and have a 4+ save, they can take only 1 hit. Destroyed Boats are removed from play, any crew drowns immediately. Spells may effect Boats (using the 4+ save). Unmanned Boats (except Bomb Boat) are immediately removed from play.
